metadata.description: auditor-skill — Solana + full-stack security audit skill

plugins.name: auditor
plugins.description: Solana + full-stack security auditor: three depths and a CI mode (Quick reviews, Standard and Full audits, a pull-request workflow), a full audit-firm lifecycle (automated + interactive), history-seeded threat models, executable PoC + fix-patch delivery, a Rust pre-scanner + cross-audit memory, scope-gated loading, native rigor gates, orchestrated Trail of Bits execution tooling, a post-incident detection & response track (hunt + respond over transaction history, propose-only), and security checks that are opt-in, with a strict mode for untrusted code.
